prompt: help me plan my weekend trip to yosemite
response: Yosemite is a beautiful destination for a weekend trip! You can start by visiting the iconic Yosemite Valley, where you'll find Half Dome and El Capitan. Be sure to take a short hike to see Bridalveil Fall. If you're feeling adventurous, you can try rock climbing or take a guided tour. There are plenty of places to stay, from campgrounds to luxury lodges. Don't forget to bring your camera to capture the stunning views!
